source_notes: The paper uses the name sodium dodecylbenzene sulfate (DBS); its connectivity/isomer is not independently assigned.
Figure 2b/c electron-beam transformations are characterization artifacts, not new synthesis records.
The fresh colloid and XRD powder come from the DBS route but are distinct physical specimen states.
Methods call the wash alcohol; discussion of the DBS-route separated powder calls it absolute alcohol (main p.3 / printed 349). The chemical identity remains unspecified.
remaining_gaps: Exact solution volumes, addition rate and duration unreported.
Alcohol wash identity unreported; ethanol not assumed.
Storage temperature, light and vessel conditions unreported.
Fresh and aged colloid phases not separately measured; Ag unit cell is an external bulk reference only.
training_note: Three process/product states retain source scopes. Authored diagrams and external Ag reference are not measured product atom coordinates.
